items.title: MD Studio plugin: powerful Markdown browser/editor with docking tabs, reference chains, splits, 4 views, snippets, Claude-file wizards
items.detail: Brett Nov 2 2026 21:30 ET: powerful MD file browser/editor. Opens multiple md files in a tab group with floating, dockable, resizable tabs. A column lists every md file in collapsible categories by scope: Project, Claude, Repo; an edit switch makes a file editable. If a file references other files the chain shows as branches; clicking a referenced name splits the viewing area (setting: vertical or horizontal). Right-click any file in the column: open in horizontal or vertical split. A split section can be undocked, floated, and dropped as a tab in any tab header or into a split (the split shows while hovering). Toolbar with 3 views plus a 4th IDE-style view, each changing how everything renders. Drag snippets into files; wizards that create Claude md files (CLAUDE.md, rules, persona, threads, skills...), categorized by what they do and by scope (project, Claude, repo). Builds on dock-engine.
